transactions.counterparty: Mirvac Funds Management Australia Limited, as trustee of Mirvac Wholesale Office Fund I
transactions.citation: p38: acquisition of a 50% interest in 255 George Street for headline A$363.8 million; p125 cash-flow Note A: investment property S$318,367k + financial asset at FVTPL S$2,468k = S$320,835k; p139 Note 3: consideration approximately S$320,981k; p38 fn1: CIVAS (NSW) Pty Limited independent valuation of the 50% interest was A$363.8m with rent guarantee (A$358.9m without), as at 1 March 2024
transactions.notes: Acquisition, not a divestment — gain_loss_pct left null (no defensible divestment-style premium/discount metric disclosed; the acquisition price A$363.8m equals the independent valuation with rent guarantee, i.e. bought at valuation, not at a premium/discount). purchase_price S$320,835k is the audited total purchase consideration (Note A, p125). Headline local-currency consideration: A$363.8 million for the 50% interest. Audited FYE2024 carrying value S$322,131k; independent valuation as at 31 Dec 2024 S$323,363k.
